column1: # A person's reading of a Debian copyright file that is not machine-readable
# (LICENSE-001), which tool/check_bundle_licences.js cannot read itself: the
# package, the SHA-256 of the file as read, the SPDX expression of what the
# package ships, as licences.tsv reads it, and what the reading found. A file
# whose bytes differ is unread again, so a package update that changes its
# notices fails until it is read anew.
